stories.title: Deestriders race at Arrowe Park and Trailfest half marathon
stories.summary: Deestriders runners raced on the Wirral and in the Trailfest half marathon in the week beginning 21 September. Paul Lewtey was the club’s first finisher in the fourth Arrowe Park multi-terrain race on Tuesday 22 September, in 27:27. stories.title: Deeside community gym creates outdoor exercise area for people put off by traditional gyms
stories.summary: A Deeside community gym has bought equipment for a new outdoor exercise area aimed at people who would rather not train in a conventional gym. stories.title: North Wales man jailed over £4m of machinery obtained on finance
stories.summary: A Prestatyn man has been jailed for five years after taking heavy plant machinery on finance and selling it abroad without repaying the loans. stories.title: Flintshire roadworks: closures and temporary traffic lights across the county this week
stories.summary: Road closures and temporary traffic lights are in place across Flintshire this week, with works in Shotton, Mold, Buckley, Hope and Pen-y-ffordd among those listed in Flintshire County Council’s roadworks bulletin.
